$comment: NG EarSafe AI-first operating spine. Three hook jobs: (1) the PreToolUse APPROVAL GATE (Company_OS/_observability/approval_gate.py) denies every live-mutation tool unless NG_EXECUTE=1 (only /execute-approved sets it) — the primary defense is each agent's read-only tool allowlist; this hook is the secondary net. The ONE exception: Porter misroutes the read-only analytics call query_data through the Porter__execute dispatcher, so the gate inspects the inner tool_id and lets exactly that read through (so agents can pull deep analytics in scheduled runs) while still blocking every real Porter/Shopify/Meta/Gmail/Canva/Drive mutation. (2) the SessionStart GUARD warns if you launched from the wrong directory (must be the git root, not inside Company_OS/). (3) the OBSERVABILITY logger (Company_OS/_observability/log.sh) records every event to a trace so /trace-view can prove config==actual. The logger always exits 0 and never blocks anything.

hooks.command: if [ ! -f "Company_OS/COMPANY_STATE.md" ]; then echo '⚠️  NG EarSafe: launch from the GIT ROOT (…/Claude Team), not inside Company_OS/. Company_OS/COMPANY_STATE.md was not found from this directory — the read-order paths in CLAUDE.md and the agents will break.' >&2; else echo 'NG EarSafe AI-first OS active. Read order: CLAUDE.md -> Company_OS/COMPANY_STATE.md -> the relevant departments/<dept>/ triad -> draft to APPROVALS_QUEUE.md. No live writes outside /execute-approved.'; fi
